lastAfter:
ZULU1 The clearing held its breath and the girl lifted her hands.

ZULU2 "I wish for Lirael to find the father who abandoned her," she said.

ZULU3 The Dohkar hand froze halfway to the seal.

ZULU4 I tore the band from my mouth and crossed the braided ground.

ZULU5 Julian did not move, which was the thing I noticed.

I realize that old tarot deck is still in my hand. Reassuringly solid. Present. One of the heavy gold cards slips out — "Petition Fate" is inscribed in it. If only it were that easy.
